expected_transactions.note: read temperature: write pointer 0x00 then read 2 bytes

test_stimuli.name: mechanical_single_channel_positive
test_stimuli.derivation: SECTION B3 semantic_kind=physical_scaled;  bytes 0x32 0x00 decode to raw=((((0x32 << 8) | 0x00) >> 5) & 0x7FF) = 400; public value in milli_degC is 400 * 125000 = 50000000.

test_stimuli.name: mechanical_single_channel_zero
test_stimuli.derivation: SECTION B3 semantic_kind=physical_scaled; zero-value  bytes 0x00 0x00 decode to raw=((((0x00 << 8) | 0x00) >> 5) & 0x7FF) = 0; public value in milli_degC is 0 * 125000 = 0.

test_stimuli.name: mechanical_single_channel_negative
test_stimuli.derivation: SECTION B3 semantic_kind=physical_scaled; negative two's-complement  bytes 0xCE 0x00 decode to raw=(((((0xCE << 8) | 0x00) >> 5) & 0x7FF) - 2048) = -400; public value in milli_degC is -400 * 125000 = -50000000.
